crossRefs.note: The man rose up to depart; but his father-in-law urged him, and he stayed there again.

translations.web: The man rose up to depart; but his father-in-law urged him, and he stayed there again.
translations.bsb: The man got up to depart, but his father-in-law persuaded him, so he stayed there that night.
translations.kjv: And when the man rose up to depart, his father in law urged him: therefore he lodged there again.
translations.asv: And the man rose up to depart; but his father-in-law urged him, and he lodged there again.
